mapper.select: WITH connections AS ( SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(peer_id, ''), 'Unknown') AS peer_id, MAX(COALESCE(NULLIF(peer_client_name, ''), 'Unknown')) AS client_name, MAX(GREATEST(to_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS upload, MAX(GREATEST(from_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS download FROM public.ban_history WHERE populate_time >= #{startAt} AND populate_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY userapps_id, torrent_id, peer_ip, peer_port, COALESCE(NULLIF(peer_id, ''), 'Unknown') UNION ALL SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(peer_id, ''), 'Unknown'), COALESCE(NULLIF(peer_client_name, ''), 'Unknown'), GREATEST(to_peer_traffic, 0)::numeric, GREATEST(from_peer_traffic, 0)::numeric FROM public.swarm_tracker WHERE last_time_seen >= #{startAt} AND last_time_seen < #{endAt} ) SELECT peer_idclient_name AS city, SUM(upload)::text AS upload_bytes, SUM(download)::text AS download_bytes FROM connections GROUP BY city HAVING SUM(upload) + SUM(download) > 0 ORDER BY SUM(upload) + SUM(download) DESC, city LIMIT 100

WITH city_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT city, SUM(upload_bytes)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download_bytes)::numeric AS download FROM public.dashboard_ban_city_traffic WHERE range_days = #{days} GROUP BY city
SELECT latest.city, SUM(latest.upload_bytes)::numeric AS upload, SUM(latest.download_bytes)::numeric AS download FROM ( SELECT ban_history.userapps_id, ban_history.torrent_id, ban_history.peer_ip, ban_history.peer_port, COALESCE(ban_history.peer_id, '') AS peer_id, MAX(COALESCE( NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' )) AS city, MAX(GREATEST(ban_history.to_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS upload_bytes, MAX(GREATEST(ban_history.from_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS download_bytes FROM public.ban_history WHERE ban_history.populate_time >= #{startAt} AND ban_history.populate_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY ban_history.userapps_id, ban_history.torrent_id, ban_history.peer_ip, ban_history.peer_port, COALESCE(ban_history.peer_id, '') ) latest GROUP BY latest.city
), top_cities AS ( ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY upload DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY download DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) ), totals AS ( SELECT SUM(upload)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download)::numeric AS download FROM city_totals ) SELECT NULL::text AS city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM totals UNION ALL SELECT city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT city, upload, download FROM top_cities ) selected

WITH city_totals AS MATERIALIZED (
SELECT city, SUM(upload_bytes)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download_bytes)::numeric AS download FROM public.dashboard_swarm_hourly_traffic WHERE bucket >= #{startAt} AND bucket < #{endAt} GROUP BY city
SELECT COALESCE( NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' ) AS city, SUM(GREATEST(to_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS upload, SUM(GREATEST(from_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS download FROM public.swarm_tracker WHERE last_time_seen >= #{startAt} AND last_time_seen < #{endAt} GROUP BY city
), top_cities AS ( ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY upload DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) UNION ALL ( SELECT city, upload, download FROM city_totals ORDER BY download DESC, city LIMIT #{limit} ) ), totals AS ( SELECT SUM(upload)::numeric AS upload, SUM(download)::numeric AS download FROM city_totals ) SELECT NULL::text AS city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM totals UNION ALL SELECT city, upload::text AS upload_bytes, download::text AS download_bytes FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT city, upload, download FROM top_cities ) selected
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.dashboard_swarm_hourly_traffic ( bucket, city, upload_bytes, download_bytes, refreshed_at ) SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', last_time_seen) AS bucket, COALESCE( NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' ) AS city, SUM(GREATEST(to_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS upload_bytes, SUM(GREATEST(from_peer_traffic, 0))::numeric AS download_bytes, NOW() FROM public.swarm_tracker WHERE last_time_seen >= #{startAt} AND last_time_seen < #{endAt} GROUP BY bucket, city ON CONFLICT (bucket, city) DO UPDATE SET upload_bytes = EXCLUDED.upload_bytes, download_bytes = EXCLUDED.download_bytes, refreshed_at = EXCLUDED.refreshed_at

INSERT INTO public.dashboard_ban_connection_traffic ( userapps_id, torrent_id, peer_ip, peer_port, peer_id, city, upload_bytes, download_bytes, last_seen_at ) SELECT ban_history.userapps_id, ban_history.torrent_id, ban_history.peer_ip, ban_history.peer_port, COALESCE(ban_history.peer_id, '') AS peer_id, MAX(COALESCE( NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' )) AS city, MAX(GREATEST(ban_history.to_peer_traffic, 0)) AS upload_bytes, MAX(GREATEST(ban_history.from_peer_traffic, 0)) AS download_bytes, MAX(ban_history.populate_time) AS last_seen_at FROM public.ban_history WHERE ban_history.populate_time >= #{startAt} AND ban_history.populate_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY ban_history.userapps_id, ban_history.torrent_id, ban_history.peer_ip, ban_history.peer_port, COALESCE(ban_history.peer_id, '') ON CONFLICT ( userapps_id, torrent_id, peer_ip, peer_port, peer_id ) DO UPDATE SET city = EXCLUDED.city, upload_bytes = EXCLUDED.upload_bytes, download_bytes = EXCLUDED.download_bytes, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at WHERE EXCLUDED.last_seen_at > dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.last_seen_at OR ( EXCLUDED.last_seen_at = dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.last_seen_at AND ( EXCLUDED.upload_bytes > dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.upload_bytes OR EXCLUDED.download_bytes > dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.download_bytes ) )

INSERT INTO public.dashboard_ban_connection_traffic ( userapps_id, torrent_id, peer_ip, peer_port, peer_id, city, upload_bytes, download_bytes, last_seen_at ) SELECT ban_history.userapps_id, ban_history.torrent_id, ban_history.peer_ip, ban_history.peer_port, COALESCE(ban_history.peer_id, '') AS peer_id, MAX(COALESCE( NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{city,cnCity}', ''), NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{city,name}', ''), NULLIF(ban_history.peer_geoip #>> '{country,name}', ''), 'Unknown' )) AS city, MAX(GREATEST(ban_history.to_peer_traffic, 0)) AS upload_bytes, MAX(GREATEST(ban_history.from_peer_traffic, 0)) AS download_bytes, MAX(ban_history.populate_time) AS last_seen_at FROM public.ban_history WHERE ban_history.insert_time >= #{startAt} AND ban_history.insert_time < #{endAt} GROUP BY ban_history.userapps_id, ban_history.torrent_id, ban_history.peer_ip, ban_history.peer_port, COALESCE(ban_history.peer_id, '') ON CONFLICT ( userapps_id, torrent_id, peer_ip, peer_port, peer_id ) DO UPDATE SET city = EXCLUDED.city, upload_bytes = EXCLUDED.upload_bytes, download_bytes = EXCLUDED.download_bytes, last_seen_at = EXCLUDED.last_seen_at WHERE EXCLUDED.last_seen_at > dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.last_seen_at OR ( EXCLUDED.last_seen_at = dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.last_seen_at AND ( EXCLUDED.upload_bytes > dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.upload_bytes OR EXCLUDED.download_bytes > dashboard_ban_connection_traffic.download_bytes ) )

INSERT INTO public.dashboard_ban_city_hourly_traffic ( hour, city, upload_bytes, download_bytes ) SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', last_seen_at) AS hour, city, SUM(upload_bytes)::numeric AS upload_bytes, SUM(download_bytes)::numeric AS download_bytes FROM public.dashboard_ban_connection_traffic WHERE last_seen_at >= #{cutoff} GROUP BY time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', last_seen_at), city ON CONFLICT (hour, city) DO UPDATE SET upload_bytes = EXCLUDED.upload_bytes, download_bytes = EXCLUDED.download_bytes

INSERT INTO public.dashboard_ban_city_traffic ( range_days, city, upload_bytes, download_bytes, generated_at ) WITH current_hour AS ( SELECT time_bucket(INTERVAL '1 hour', NOW()) + INTERVAL '1 hour' AS range_end ), windows AS ( SELECT hourly.city, COALESCE(SUM(upload_bytes) FILTER ( WHERE hour >= current_hour.range_end - INTERVAL '1 day' ), 0)::numeric AS upload_1d, COALESCE(SUM(download_bytes) FILTER ( WHERE hour >= current_hour.range_end - INTERVAL '1 day' ), 0)::numeric AS download_1d, COALESCE(SUM(upload_bytes) FILTER ( WHERE hour >= current_hour.range_end - INTERVAL '3 days' ), 0)::numeric AS upload_3d, COALESCE(SUM(download_bytes) FILTER ( WHERE hour >= current_hour.range_end - INTERVAL '3 days' ), 0)::numeric AS download_3d, COALESCE(SUM(upload_bytes) FILTER ( WHERE hour >= current_hour.range_end - INTERVAL '7 days' ), 0)::numeric AS upload_7d, COALESCE(SUM(download_bytes) FILTER ( WHERE hour >= current_hour.range_end - INTERVAL '7 days' ), 0)::numeric AS download_7d FROM public.dashboard_ban_city_hourly_traffic hourly CROSS JOIN current_hour WHERE hourly.hour >= current_hour.range_end - INTERVAL '7 days' GROUP BY hourly.city ) SELECT ranges.range_days, windows.city, ranges.upload_bytes, ranges.download_bytes, NOW() FROM windows CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( VALUES (1::SMALLINT, upload_1d, download_1d), (3::SMALLINT, upload_3d, download_3d), (7::SMALLINT, upload_7d, download_7d) ) AS ranges(range_days, upload_bytes, download_bytes) WHERE ranges.upload_bytes > 0 OR ranges.download_bytes > 0 ON CONFLICT (range_days, city) DO UPDATE SET upload_bytes = EXCLUDED.upload_bytes, download_bytes = EXCLUDED.download_bytes, generated_at = EXCLUDED.generated_at
